```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
```

## Datasets

```{r}
nba = read.csv("nba_ppg_train.csv")
nbatest = read.csv("nba_ppg_test.csv")
```

## Libraries

```{r}
library(car) # for vif
library(nnet) # for multinom
library(mgcv) # for gam
library(randomForest) # random forest
```

## Seed

```{r}
set.seed(1234)
```

## New Variables

```{r}
# what percent of their games a player starts in
nba$starter = nba$GS/nba$G
nbatest$starter = nbatest$GS/nbatest$G
```

## Train and Split

```{r}
train <- nba %>% sample_frac(0.8)
test <- nba %>% anti_join(train)
```

## Models

### Model 1. OLS on Starter, MP, TOV

```{r}
model = lm(PTS ~ starter + MP + TOV + DRB, data=nba)
```

```{r}
error = nba$PTS - predict(model, nba)
mse = round(mean(error^2),3)
rmse = round(sqrt(mean(error^2)),3)
paste0("MSE: ", mse)
paste0("RMSE: ", rmse)

print("VIF:")
vif(model)
```

Low RMSE, but mild collinearity.

### Model 2. OLS on Starter, TOV

```{r}
model = lm(PTS ~ starter + TOV, data=nba)
```

```{r}
error = nba$PTS - predict(model, nba)
mse = round(mean(error^2),3)
rmse = round(sqrt(mean(error^2)),3)
paste0("MSE: ", mse)
paste0("RMSE: ", rmse)

print("VIF:")
vif(model)
```

### Model 3. OLS on Starter, TOV, log(MP)

```{r}
model = lm(PTS ~ starter + log(MP) + TOV, data=nba)
```

```{r}
error = nba$PTS - predict(model, nba)
mse = round(mean(error^2),3)
rmse = round(sqrt(mean(error^2)),3)
paste0("MSE: ", mse)
paste0("RMSE: ", rmse)

print("VIF:")
vif(model)
```

### Model 4. log(PTS+1) OLS on Starter, TOV, MP, GS

```{r}
model = lm(log(PTS+1) ~ MP + TOV + GS, data=nba)
```

```{r}
error = nba$PTS - exp(predict(model, nba))

mse = round(mean(error^2),3)
rmse = round(sqrt(mse),3)
paste0("MSE: ", mse)
paste0("RMSE: ", rmse)

print("VIF:")
vif(model)
```

```{r}
model = lm(log(PTS+1) ~ MP + TOV + GS + DRB, data=nba)
```

```{r}
error = nba$PTS - exp(predict(model, nba))
```

### GAM Model with GS

```{r}
gam_model = gam(PTS ~ s(GS) + s(TOV) +s(MP)+s(DRB), data=train)
```

```{r}
error = train$PTS - predict(gam_model, train)

mse = round(mean(error^2),3)
rmse = round(sqrt(mse),3)
paste0("Train MSE: ", mse)
#paste0("RMSE: ", rmse)

testerror = test$PTS - predict(gam_model, test)

testmse = round(mean(testerror^2),3)
testrmse = round(sqrt(testmse),3)
paste0("Test MSE: ", testmse)

#print("VIF:")
#vif(gam_model)

#train$gam = predict(gam_model, train)
```

### GAM with starter

```{r}
gam_model = gam(PTS ~ s(starter) + s(TOV) +s(MP)+s(DRB), data=train)
```

```{r}
error = train$PTS - predict(gam_model, train)

mse = round(mean(error^2),3)
rmse = round(sqrt(mse),3)
paste0("Train MSE: ", mse)
paste0("Train RMSE: ", rmse)

testerror = test$PTS - predict(gam_model, test)

testmse = round(mean(testerror^2),3)
testrmse = round(sqrt(testmse),3)
paste0("Test MSE: ", testmse)
paste0("Test RMSE: ", testrmse)

vif(gam_model)
```

### Random Forest

```{r}
forest<- randomForest(PTS~ MP + FG. + X3P. + X2P. + DRB + GS, data=train, ntree=500, importance=TRUE)

summary(forest)

train$forest= predict(forest, train)

errorforest = train$PTS - predict(forest, train)
sq_errorforest = errorforest^2
mseforest = mean(sq_errorforest)

```

### OLS (lowest MSE)

```{r}
model = lm(log(PTS+1) ~ starter + MP+ TOV + DRB + FG. + X3P. + X2P., data=train)
```

```{r}
error = train$PTS - exp(predict(model, train))

mse = round(mean(error^2),3)
rmse = round(sqrt(mse),3)
paste0("Train MSE: ", mse)
paste0("Train RMSE: ", rmse)


testerror = test$PTS - exp(predict(model, test))

testmse = round(mean(testerror^2),3)
testrmse = round(sqrt(testmse),3)
paste0("Test MSE: ", testmse)
paste0("Test RMSE: ", testrmse)


train$p1 = exp(predict(model, train))
test$p1 = exp(predict(model, test))

vif(model)
```

### OLS Testing

```{r}
model = lm(log(PTS+1) ~ starter + MP + TOV + DRB + X3P. + X2P., data=train)
```

```{r}
error = train$PTS - exp(predict(model, train))

mse = round(mean(error^2),3)
rmse = round(sqrt(mse),3)
paste0("Train MSE: ", mse)
paste0("Train RMSE: ", rmse)


testerror = test$PTS - exp(predict(model, test))

testmse = round(mean(testerror^2),3)
testrmse = round(sqrt(testmse),3)
paste0("Test MSE: ", testmse)
paste0("Test RMSE: ", testrmse)


train$p1 = exp(predict(model, train))
test$p1 = exp(predict(model, test))

vif(model)
```
